meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 查 X(推特)上的事情时,它经 xAI 用真实搜索:按日期限定范围、限定你点名的账号,拆成 2~3 次搜索,每条结果附 x.com 链接;还会用网页搜索交叉核对,不一致或查不到会明说。没连 xAI 时也会直说,改用网页搜索。
howto.when: 当你说「搜一下 X/推特」「看某账号的帖子」或问「X 上大家在聊什么」,且 xAI 账户已连接时,会接管。

say.text: 搜下 X 上大家这两天怎么评价英伟达财报
say.note: 会把起始日期设为昨天,按帖子返回结果并附链接。

say.text: 只看 @growth_papa 这类账号最近发的 AI 动态
say.note: 该账号会作为可信账号传给 X 搜索。

say.text: 我发了条 X 链接,帮我把下面回复的观点整理出来
say.note: 会对那个帖子跑一次读取回复的搜索。

howto.what_en: Claude searches X via xAI for you: date-bounds queries, limits to accounts you name, runs 2–3 narrower searches, cites each post's URL, and cross-checks on web search. Without xAI, it says so and only uses web search.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask for X/Twitter search, posts from an account, or what people are saying on X, as long as an xAI account is connected.

say_en.text: Search X for recent reactions to NVDA earnings.
say_en.note: Date-bounds the query and returns linked posts.

say_en.text: Search for recent AI posts only from @growth_papa.
say_en.note: Passes that handle as a trusted account.

say_en.text: I shared an X post link — summarize the replies under it.
say_en.note: Triggers a thread-fetch pass for that post.
